# Amaanullah Khan — Full-Stack Software Developer

> Full-Stack Web Application Developer & Custom Software Specialist based in Karachi, Pakistan.
> Specializing in Custom CRM Systems, SaaS Platforms, Laravel APIs, AI Automations, and Cross-Platform Mobile Apps.

## Core Capabilities
- Custom CRM & ERP Development: Tailored business systems with zero monthly user licenses.
- SaaS & Web App Development: High-performance PHP/Laravel applications, modern APIs, clean architectures.
- AI Automation & LLM Workflows: Cloudflare Workers AI, custom chatbot integration, automated lead capture.
- Mobile App Development: Flutter & Firebase for iOS and Android.
